HASHI — DEMO SCRIPT
One story, in the order a new user meets it. [Brackets] = where you are in the app and what to type or say. Don't read them.
About 561 spoken words: 3:01 at your pace (3:44 if slower). No video length rule for the Mainnet Track or the bounty; judges give a couple of minutes, so this aims at about three.

1 · OPENING · 0:00
[bchblaze.cash Stablecoin Bridge bounty page → the GitHub repo → hashi.cash home]

Howdy to the BCH BLAZE team and the Stablecoin Bridge sponsors. It's Blockchain Oracle, and I bring to you Hashi — dollars in, dollars out.

2 · WHAT IT IS · 0:08
[home, the hero]

Hashi moves dollars between the big chains and Bitcoin Cash. You bring USDC or USDT from eight chains, like Base, Ethereum or Solana, and get PUSD, MUSD or BCH on Bitcoin Cash, and back.

3 · THE PARTNERS · 0:19
[home → scroll to Built on]

NEAR Intents and THORChain carry the money between chains. Cauldron, a market on Bitcoin Cash, turns BCH into PUSD or MUSD. WalletConnect and WizardConnect connect your two wallets.

4 · THE PROBLEM · 0:28
[defillama.com/stablecoins → back to Hashi's home, "Live from the chain"]

Just a quick question. You hold USDC on Base. How do you get Bitcoin Cash dollars? There's about two hundred and forty billion dollars in USDC and USDT, and about a quarter of a million in PUSD and MUSD on Cauldron. Today you swap into BCH somewhere, open Cauldron, swap again, and add up the fees yourself. No cross-chain service lists PUSD or MUSD.

5 · THE SOLUTION · 0:48
[home → Open app]

So I built Hashi, for the Stablecoin Bridge bounty. One screen prices every route end to end, shows every fee, and walks both your wallets through each approval. It never holds your money. Let me show you.

6 · GETTING IN · 1:00
[Connect → Reown → Base wallet; then Connect a Bitcoin Cash wallet → scan the QR with Selene]

There's no sign-up. I connect my Base wallet through WalletConnect, then I scan this code with my Bitcoin Cash wallet. That's WizardConnect.

7 · THE FEATURES · 1:08
[the swap card, empty]

Here are the features, in the order you'd use them: your pair, the routes, the review, the swap, the finish on Cauldron, activity, the way back, and swaps on Bitcoin Cash.

8 · YOUR PAIR · 1:18
[You pay: USDC on Base, type 10 → You receive: PUSD]

Your pair. I pay ten USDC on Base, and I want PUSD. The picker has fourteen stablecoins on eight chains.

9 · THE ROUTES · 1:24
[the routes list; say the numbers on screen]

The routes. Hashi asks every bridge at once and ranks them by what I keep after fees. NEAR Intents into Cauldron gives me nine point eight nine PUSD, for seven cents. THORChain has paused Base right now, and Hashi says so.

10 · THE REVIEW · 1:37
[Review]

The review shows every fee, the least I can receive, both addresses, and what each wallet will ask. I press Start swap.

11 · THE SWAP · 1:45
[tracker → approve the USDC transfer in the Base wallet → Bridging; cut the wait]

The swap. My Base wallet asks once, to send the USDC. The tracker follows it across both chains, and I could close the tab now.

12 · THE FINISH ON CAULDRON · 1:53
[BCH arrived → Swap the BCH into PUSD → approve in Selene → View transaction]

The BCH has landed, so I finish on Cauldron. One approval, and the PUSD is mine. Let's confirm it. Here's the Bitcoin Cash transaction, with the PUSD at my address. It matches. You don't have to trust me.

13 · ACTIVITY · 2:05
[Activity]

Activity. Every swap is saved here in my browser, with every link.

14 · THE WAY BACK · 2:09
[Swap → flip → 5 PUSD to USDC on Base → Review → approve the sale, then the send; cut the wait]

The way back. I flip the card: five PUSD to USDC on Base. Hashi sells the PUSD on Cauldron, saves the sale, then sends the BCH it made to the bridge. Two approvals, and the USDC lands after one Bitcoin Cash block.

15 · SWAPS ON BITCOIN CASH · 2:23
[4 PUSD to MUSD → Review → approve in Selene]

Swaps on Bitcoin Cash. Four PUSD to MUSD, on Cauldron alone. One approval, about fifteen seconds.

16 · THE REST · 2:28
[settings, then the status dot]

And the rest, quickly. You can deposit USDC on Base without gas. You set your own slippage and recipient, with guards. Every service is checked live. If a price moves past your floor, nothing is signed until you choose. And the code is open source.

17 · UNDER THE HOOD · 2:42
[the tracker's NEAR Intents link → its explorer]

Under the hood, NEAR Intents' own explorer shows the same swap, on their side.

18 · DOCS AND X · 2:47
[docs.hashi.cash home: pick Base USDC to PUSD on the bridge]

It's all in the docs, at docs dot hashi dot cash. Pick where your dollars are, and the bridge lights up the real route. And follow us on X, at HANDLE.

19 · CLOSE · 2:57
[hashi.cash home]

It's live right now, at hashi dot cash. Hashi — dollars in, dollars out.

---

Have ready
- Base wallet with 10 USDC and a little ETH; Selene connected and holding a little BCH for network fees.
- Re-read the two numbers before recording: defillama.com/stablecoins (USDT plus USDC) and the PUSD and MUSD liquidity on Hashi's home.
- Cut the waits: the bridge (about 3 minutes) and the Bitcoin Cash block (about 10).
- Replace HANDLE; mention gasless only if the relayer holds Base ETH that day.
